newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Aminex Plc reports half-yr loss $0.97 mln.
newsitem.headline: Aminex Plc reports half-yr loss $0.97 mln.

text.p: Irish exploration group Aminex Plc said on Thursday that it made an pre-tax loss of $0.97 million for the six months ended 30 June, 1996 on turnover of $7.39 million.
Aminex said in a results statement that the loss resulted from higher costs relating to its Russian interests and the expansion of Oilfield Services division activities.

"Turnover at $7.39 million was 26 percent higher than the corresponding period as a result of increased sales in the Oilfield Services division, increased oil production and higher average oil prices," chairman Peter Elwes said.
He said gross profit decreased to $0.58 million from $1.17 million in the corresponding period mainly due to higher costs in Russia.
The net loss, after adjusting for minority interests, was $0.677 million versus a loss of $0.29 million in 1995.

"With our strong and established presence in Russia, our experienced management team, the support of our major shareholders and the many opportunities for growth in the Russian oil industry we feel able to view the future with confidence," Elwes said.
